subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw execute native OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls when raw SSE reaches `data: [DONE]` but no final `finish_reason` is present?
rationale: This choice changes when provider output becomes executable tool calls, and repository policy treats fallback and tool-execution boundaries as maintainer decisions rather than automation defaults.

options.title: Accept clean-DONE native tool calls
options.body: Land the linked fix path if maintainers accept raw SSE `[DONE]` plus native `delta.tool_calls` as a sufficient clean completion signal.

options.title: Keep requiring finish_reason
options.body: Reject the behavior change if maintainers want all streamed tool execution to require an explicit provider finish reason.

options.title: Require exact-provider proof first
options.body: Ask for one redacted Evolink or equivalent live-provider run before deciding the execution contract.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-DONE native tool calls
recommendation.body: Land the linked fix path if maintainers accept raw SSE `[DONE]` plus native `delta.tool_calls` as a sufficient clean completion signal.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the adjacent tool-call safety changes and is the clearest history-backed decision owner for accepting or rejecting the widened execution boundary.
